issue_context.body:

Emergency heat mode is Rheem Econet's aux_heat mode. When activated, integration reports:

                  ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^^^^^^^^

review_comments:
This is problematic.

If you set one state, it would jump to another once an update is received?

Honestly, looking at this, emergency heat should probably be extracted into a separate switch entity.

../Frenck

EMERGENCY_HEAT is already a separate switch, which is the correct model for HA, I think. It doesn't represent the thermostat well though, because it's a separate mode. The thermostat is either in HEAT or EMERGENCY_HEAT, not both. But because we can't add climate modes, this is how it must be done. Ideally I'd prefer to see it as a climate model.

And yes, the behavior was that I would set it to HEAT mode, and HA would also set the EMERGENCY_HEAT switch.

aah check, got it! Thanks for the clarification 👍 

../Frenck
